title: Message threads carry an optional section; threads include filters by section
description: Thread entries in threads.json and per-thread files get an optional section title (derived from the Reference or Story, overridden by MessageThread.sectionId). ::include{kind=threads section=...} filters; the Markdown twin applies the same filter. Docs in docs/home-page.md.
